exchanges: Okay, I officially live in Dallas now. The moving truck got here before I did.
Welcome. Lucky the truck was on time.
The new job is at Cartwheel, the big fulfilment centre off the interstate. I think I'm going to like it.
Good to start with a positive feeling. What will you be doing?
I'm a trainer for the new hires, mostly safety and scanners.
That is a role where patience pays off.
My partner Reza is still in Phoenix until his lease ends, so it's just me and too many boxes.
A quiet few weeks to set up the place how you like it.
His birthday is in January and I already feel bad that we'll be apart for it.
Maybe you can plan a visit or a surprise.
My coworker Daniela gave me a ride today. She lives in Plano, so it was on her way.
Nice of her, a ride makes the first days easier.
Funny, she has the same name as my mom.
That must be a little strange to say out loud.
Speaking of my mom, she's already planning a visit from Tucson. She's never been to Texas.
Moms move fast on that.
I got a migraine on the drive here, which is classic for me. I get migraines whenever I'm stressed.
Moving is stressful, so try to take it easy this week.
My nephew Kalani just got into Baylor for nursing, the whole family is thrilled.
That is great news for him.
He's the first one in the family to go to university.
That is a big moment.
I keep blasting Paramore while I unpack, it's the only thing keeping me going.
Good unpacking music makes a difference.
My manager Liam plays pickleball every lunch break, apparently it's a whole thing at the office.
That sport has taken over a lot of workplaces.
I'm going to try a Spanish class at the community college, half my team speaks it.
That will help a lot with the team.
My aunt Ofelia will be thrilled. She always said I should learn since she's Salvadoran, and I never did.
She will love hearing about the class.
I'm driving my old Prius around here and I feel like the only small car in Texas.
Texas does love its trucks.
My old roommate Thandiwe is coming to visit in a few weeks.
Nice to have a familiar face come by.
She's really into birding and says the lakes here are good for it.
There are some good spots around the lakes for that.
Wait, I got that wrong about Kalani. It's Tulane, not Baylor. Baylor was his backup.
Still great news either way.
The heat here is no joke, even at night.
Summers here are tough. Stay cool.
Liam has a dog named Bandit who comes to the office on Fridays.
An office dog is a great perk.
I need to buy curtains tomorrow, the sun comes in at six.
Blackout curtains would help.
Where did I say Daniela from work lives?

earlier_question.right_reply: Daniela from work lives in Plano.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Daniela from work lives in Tucson.

questions.message: What language am I going to study?
What did Liam call his pup?
I think I'll grab some groceries on the way home tomorrow.
What car does my aunt drive?
Sorry, which city is Daniela from work in?
